{{Enemy Echo Tabs}} {{Enemy Infobox |name = Lady of the Sea |title = Embers of Glory |image = Lady of the Sea Icon.png |dmgtype = Aero |weakpoint = Unknown |echo = Yes |class = Overlord |family = Tacet Discord |group = Dark Tide Creation |nation = Rinascita |region = Septimont |subregion = Capitoline Hill |drops = Abyssal Husk |variants = Tactical Hologram: Lady of the Sea }} '''Lady of the Sea''' {{Lang|zh=海之女}} is an [[Overlord Class]] [[Boss]] in ''[[Wuthering Waves]]'' that can be found in {{Location|Capitoline Hill}}, and is unlocked after completing {{Quest|Flames of Heart}}. ==Drops== {{Boss Rewards|regular=1|exclusive=Abyssal Husk}} ==Stats== {{Enemy Stats}} ==Abilities== ==Trophies== {{Trophies|Lady of the Sea}} ==Description== {{Description|This enemy has {{Color|help|higher RES}} against {{Color|Aero DMG}}.

A [[Mya|fallen one]] adrift in the frigid currents, a ruptured remnant in which the Threnodian's residual energy resides.

She pierced her own heart and fell into the ocean. But fate, relentless as the whirlpools below, dragged her even deeper.

Now, her [[Leviathan|creator]] has claimed this failed vessel, lying in wait beneath the waves to devour the entire world.|Description When Discovered}} ==Soundtracks== {{Soundtracks by Category Table|type=combat}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Lady of the Sea |zhs = 海之女 |zht = 海之女 |ja = 海の娘 |ko = 바다의 여인 |fr = Dame de la Mer |de = Herrin des Meeres |es = Dama Marina }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.6|introduced=2.4}} ==Navigation== {{Enemy Navbox}}
